lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har bhaj sabh kilabikh kaat ||
lines.translation: O my mind, meditate, vibrate on the Lord, and all sins will be eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har ur dhaario gur poorai meraa sees keejai gur vaat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has enshried the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; I place my head on the Guru's Path. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere har prabh kee mai baat sunaavai tis man devau kat kaat ||
lines.translation: Whoever tells me the stories of my Lord God, I would cut my mind into slices, and dedicate it to him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਹਟਿ ਹਾਟ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har saajan melio gur poorai gur bachan bikaano hat haat ||1||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, my Friend; I have sold myself at each and every store for the Guru's Word. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਗਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਧ ਕਾਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: makar praag daan bahu keeaa sareer deeo adh kaat ||
lines.translation: One may give donations in charity at Prayaag, and cut the body in two at Benares,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin har naam ko mukat na paavai bahu ka(n)chan deejai kat kaat ||2||
lines.translation: but without the Lord's Name, no one attains liberation, even though one may give away huge amounts of gold. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਘਰੇ ਕਪਟ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keerat guramat jas gaaio man ughare kapat kapaat ||
lines.translation: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, and sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the doors of the mind, held shut by deception, are thrown open again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਲਜ ਭਾਨੀ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: trikutee phor bharam bhau bhaagaa laj bhaanee matukee maat ||3||
lines.translation: The three qualities are shattered, doubt and fear run away, and the clay pot of public opinion is broken. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalajug gur pooraa tin paaiaa jin dhur masatak likhe lilaat ||
lines.translation: They alone find the Perfect Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਖਾਟ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ras a(n)mrit peeaa sabh laathee bhookh tikhaat ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; all his hunger and thirst are quenched. ||4||6|| Set of Six Hymns 1||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man tahal har sukh saar ||
lines.translation: O mind, true peace comes from serving the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਟਹਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar tahalaa jhootheeaa nit karai jam sir maar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Other services are false, and as punishment for them, the Messenger of Death bashes in one's head. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa masatak leekhiaa te mile sa(n)gaar ||
lines.translation: They alone join the Sangat, the Congregation, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar bhaujal taariaa har sa(n)t purakh apaar ||1||
lines.translation: They are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Saints of the Infinite, Primal Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit charan sevahu saadh ke taj lobh moh bikaar ||
lines.translation: Serve forever at the feet of the Holy; renounce greed, emotional attachment and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤਜਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸੜੀ ਰਖੁ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tajahu doojee aasaRee rakh aas ik nira(n)kaar ||2||
lines.translation: Abandon all other hopes, and rest your hopes in the One Formless Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik bharam bhoole saakataa bin gur a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
lines.translation: Some are faithless cynics, deluded by doubt; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਕੋ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dhur hovanaa s hoiaa ko na metanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever is pre-ordained, comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam roop gobi(n)d kaa anik naam apaar ||
lines.translation: The beauty of the Lord of the Universe is profound and unfathomable; the Names of the Infinite Lord are immunerable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dha(n)n te jan naanakaa jin har naamaa ur dhaar ||4||1||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, O Nanak, who enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts. ||4||1||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
I humbly bow to the Name of the Lord.
Chanting it, one is saved. ||1||Pause||
Meditating on Him in remembrance, conflicts are ended.
Meditating on Him, one's bonds are untied.
Meditating on Him, the fool becomes wise.
Meditating on Him, one's ancestors are saved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simaran bhau dukh harai ||
lines.translation: Meditating on Him, fear and pain are taken away.
Meditating on Him, misfortune is avoided.
Meditating on Him, sins are erased.
Meditating on Him, agony is ended. ||2||
Meditating on Him, the heart blossoms forth.
Meditating on Him, Maya becomes one's slave.
Meditating on Him, one is blessed with the treasures of wealth.
Meditating on Him, one crosses over in the end. ||3||
The Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.
It saves millions of devotees.
I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
Nanak lays his forehead on the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
This is the sort of helper the Name of the Lord is.
Meditating in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||
It is like a boat to a drowning man.
